entries.title: Explanations flags the passages likely to trip you
entries.body: A new Explanations mode lists the passages in your articles where a reader is likely to get stuck, each with a short note giving the missing step or background, and says when it is unsure or is drawing on what the AI already knows, unchecked against the article. Turn on Experimental features on your profile page and it appears under More, after Glossary; nothing is written when you add an article, only when you choose the mode. With Marginalia also on, the notes appear beside the text. Exporting an article includes its explanations too.
